Class AsyncDeleteBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractDeleteBuilder<T, AsyncDeleteBuilder<T>>
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.async.AsyncDeleteBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the item
public class AsyncDeleteBuilder<T> extends AbstractDeleteBuilder<T, AsyncDeleteBuilder<T>>
Async fluent builder for deleting an item from a DynamoDB table by its key, with an optional condition expression. Part of the DynamoDB Simplified library.
